Subject: Security exhibit questions: SOC 2 evidence cadence and pen test window

Hi Markus,

Thanks for sending the draft security exhibit. A couple items for clarity before we proceed to legal: 

- SOC 2 evidence: can you confirm the monthly vs quarterly evidence cadence for operational logs (audit logs, data retention proof) you expect Redwood to share? Our compliance team prefers a quarterly push but we have customers that ask for monthly snapshots.
- Pen test access window: the exhibit currently asks for "reasonable access" for a penetration test. We need specific timing constraints (e.g., 2 weeks notice, 24-48 hour maintenance windows) and confirmation whether Redwood will permit external testers on dedicated infra or require a staging environment.
- Incident evidence: what artifacts will be available on request (raw logs, redacted traces, post-incident timeline)?

We appreciate any specifics you can provide. If it's easier, a short mutual action plan and a proposed evidence schedule would help speed legal review.

Thanks,

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below; attaching a redlined exhibit with concrete options so your counsel can pick the path that matches your risk appetite.

Quick answers: 
- Evidence cadence: We propose a quarterly scheduled evidence bundle by default (monthly on request as a paid add-on). The quarterly bundle includes: SOC 2 Type II report (if available), audit log extracts (7-day rolling + quarterly snapshots), configuration change summaries, and a list of recent security incidents (redacted). For customers that require monthly snapshots we can include a monthly audit-log snapshot with a 30-day rolling retention addendum.
- Pen test logistics: Redwood can support external pen testers only on a customer-specific staging environment or dedicated non-prod isolated pool. For production testing we require a 14 calendar day notice, a scoped test plan, and pre-test coordination with our security ops team; testing is restricted to agreed maintenance windows (typically 02:00–06:00 UTC). We do not permit arbitrary external testing on shared multi-tenant production nodes.
- Incident evidence: We can provide redacted raw logs, timeline artifacts, and query outputs for the affected timeframe. Full raw log dumps require an NDA + data handling plan; short extracts and timelines are part of the standard evidence bundle.

Attached: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v2_redlines.pdf — contains two variants: 
  A) Standard (quarterly evidence, staging-only pen tests)
  B) Enhanced (monthly snapshots + limited production pen tests under strict controls)

Next step: If this works, I'll loop in Legal (Laura) and Security (Karthik) to confirm final wording and the notice windows.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

> Attached: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v2_redlines.pdf — contains two variants:
> A) Standard (quarterly evidence, staging-only pen tests)
> B) Enhanced (monthly snapshots + limited production pen tests under strict controls)

Suggested redlines / operational guardrails (high priority):
- Pen test: explicitly call out "staging environment by default; production testing only with 14-day notice, scoped test plan, and a mutual rollback plan; no active exploitation of live customer data." This reduces ambiguity.
- Evidence cadence: keep default quarterly. Add optional language: "Customer may request monthly evidence snapshots subject to additional fees and a 5-business-day fulfillment SLA."
- Data access artifacts: define "redacted logs" vs "raw logs" and require an NDA + secure transfer mechanism (S3 presigned URL with timebound access or direct secure FTP) for anything beyond summaries.
- Scheduling: propose a standing quarterly evidence upload on the 10th business day following quarter-end; ad-hoc requests get a 10-business-day SLA.

Action items: 
- Laura: can Legal sign off on the monthly-addendum language and the pen-test production clause?
- Priyom: can Ops confirm staging isolation and the 02:00–06:00 UTC maintenance window feasibility for customers in US/EU?

I can prepare final clause text for Legal if you want.

--
Karthik
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

1) A written confirmation in the exhibit that production testing is disallowed unless both parties explicitly agree in writing and a scoped plan + 14-day notice are received.
2) Quarterly evidence bundle delivered by the 10th business day after quarter close.
3) A contact (security liaison) and escalation path for urgent evidence requests or incident correlation.

If you can add the three items to the redline and return an updated PDF, our legal team will aim to complete review within 5 business days. Also, could you confirm whether Redwood requires an MSA amendment for the monthly snapshot add-on or whether that will be handled via order form terms?

We'll take the staging-only approach for now and may escalate to the Enhanced variant if our audit scope changes.
